meta.name: what-the
meta.description: What the? Use when the user wants a plain-English breakdown of something technical — the who, what, where, why, and when.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需要向非技术人员解释技术概念
copy.tagline_en: Explain any technical concept in plain English

howto.what: 当用户要求解释某个技术概念时，Claude 会用通俗语言从谁、什么、哪里、为什么、何时五个角度进行拆解。
howto.when: 当用户说“解释一下这个技术概念”或类似请求时触发。

say.text: 解释一下区块链的who, what, where, why, when
say.note: Claude 会用大白话从五个角度拆解区块链。

howto.what_en: When the user asks for an explanation of a technical concept, Claude breaks it down in plain English from five angles: who, what, where, why, and when.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says something like 'explain this technical concept' or similar requests.

say_en.text: Explain blockchain using who, what, where, why, when
say_en.note: Claude will break down blockchain in plain English.

say_en.text: Tell me what an API is with who, what, where, why, when
say_en.note: Claude will explain API in simple terms.
